title: 宝塚記念の後に・2つの理想

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd roars with excitement during the Takarazuka Kinen as they watch Silence Suzuka surge forward with the speed definitive of this new generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright is taken aback, but the event has also lit a new fire beneath her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: These two racers, both determined to continue improving, swear to race together again at the autumn Tenno Sho.
